title: Braceurself Ltd v NHS England
description: NHS England's evaluators made a manifest error in marking question CSD02 (clinical and service delivery) by misunderstanding Braceurself's answer concerning patient access to first-floor premises. The evaluators read this as a reference to a stair lift, but it was actually a stair-climber. This error resulted in a 2.25 percentage points gap between Braceurself's score of 80.25% and the successful bidder's score of 82.5%. Despite finding the manifest error, the judge concluded that the breach was not sufficiently serious to warrant damages.
